newsitem.title: CANADA: Brookfield Properites lauches share issue.
newsitem.headline: Brookfield Properites lauches share issue.

text.p: Brookfield Properities Corp on Monday said it plans to raise about C$300 million through the issue of new shares in order to finance its purchase of 25 percent of World Financial Properties in New York.
The Toronto-based real estate company said it agreed to sell 19.67 million common shares at a price of C$15.25 per share to an investment dealer group led by CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc.

Brookfield said the shares would be payable in two instalments, C$8.75 on closing, expected to be May 28, 1997, and C$6.50 on or before February 13, 1998, when the company's other common share instalment receipts are due.
Brookfield said its controlling shareholder, Edper Group Limited, agreed to subscribe for 6.56 million of the shares for total proceeds of C$100 million.
